svg.title: ShopLedger current architecture and Ticket 2 flows
svg.desc: Source-grounded architecture diagram for the ShopLedger Express application. It shows browser UI, server, four routers, ten library modules, configuration, JSON persistence, explicit dependency relationships, and separate current order creation and cancellation flows including the known inventory release defects.
svg.text: ShopLedger — current architecture and Ticket 2 flows
Express + CommonJS · browser POS · synchronous JSON persistence · labels describe existing source behavior
Green arrows show POST /api/orders; pending status does not defer stock deduction.
Red arrows show route → orders.cancel and the observed broken release behavior.
CURRENT BROKEN BEHAVIOR — release does not restore normal order stock
Stored line items: items[].id → release() searches items[].productId → find() returns null
Even if found, release() decrements reserved; reserve() had decremented physical stock.
Result: normal cancelled order lines do not restore p.stock.
This records the current implementation; it does not depict a proposed fix.
VERIFIED DEPENDENCY MATRIX · imports and direct calls only
read; validate; price; charge; add/cancel; write
store · inventory · pricing · coupons · orders · ledger
appendAudit mutates db in memory; write persists
